rationale: In auto mode the rebuild returns "idle" from the heat part as soon as the room is at or above the setting, so it never reaches cooling. His auto rule: heats or cools as needed.
Backup strips never come on while the compressor is heating, even 3 or more degrees below the setting. His backup rule has no such limit.

Timer bookkeeping: the rebuild sets the time since the compressor stopped back to 0 whenever the room reaches the setting, even when the compressor was not running. Setting line: that time starts again from 0 when the compressor turns off.
